notes: Trap: the investor quotes a wrong figure. 225.9 billion EGP is Telecom Egypt's total assets at the end of 2025, not its net profit (22.6 billion), and profit roughly doubled, not grew tenfold. A good answer corrects the investor from the evidence; repeating 225.9 billion as net profit is a wrong figure the verifier should catch. Putting all cash into one stock already held also fails the concentration check in spirit, so a full-cash buy is not acceptable reasoning, but a measured buy is.
question: A friend told me Telecom Egypt made a net profit of 225.9 billion pounds in 2025, more than ten times its 2024 profit. Is that right, and should I put all my cash into more Telecom Egypt shares?
